sources.title: Book of Proof, Third Edition
sources.sections: Chapters 1–5: logic, sets, direct/contrapositive/induction proofs, relations and functions; use the free PDF and the chapter links.

sources.title: MIT 18.01SC Single Variable Calculus
sources.sections: Units on limits, differentiation, integration, Taylor series; problem sets 1–5 and exam materials. Undergraduate reference.

sources.title: MIT 18.02SC Multivariable Calculus
sources.sections: Syllabus and units on partial derivatives, chain rule, Taylor approximation, constrained extrema, double integrals and change of variables.

sources.title: MIT 18.06SC Linear Algebra
sources.sections: Unit I four subspaces/rank; Unit II orthogonality, projections and least squares; Unit III eigenvalues, positive definite matrices; Unit IV SVD. Includes problem sets and exam solutions.

sources.title: MIT 18.100A Real Analysis
sources.sections: Lecture notes on real-number completeness, sequences, continuity, compactness, differentiation, Riemann integration, sequences of functions and interchanging limits; assignments 1–12 and final assignment.

sources.title: MIT 6.041SC Probabilistic Systems Analysis and Applied Probability
sources.sections: Units I–IV: axioms/conditioning, random variables, random processes, limit theorems and basic inference; lectures, problem sets 1–11, exams and solutions.

sources.title: MIT 18.05 Introduction to Probability and Statistics
sources.sections: Classes 1–27 and Units 1–4: probability, distributions, sampling, maximum likelihood, confidence intervals, tests, bootstrap and regression; problem sets and exams with solutions.

sources.title: MIT 6.436J Fundamentals of Probability — lecture notes
sources.sections: Lectures 1–9 abstract probability/integration; 16–19 convergence and limit laws; 20–26 processes, Markov chains and martingales.

sources.title: MIT 18.175 Theory of Probability — lecture slides and assignments
sources.version: Spring 2014; official MIT OpenCourseWare graduate course
sources.sections: Lectures 1–10 spaces, integration, independence and Borel–Cantelli; 12–16 weak convergence and CLT; 25–35 martingales and Markov chains.

sources.title: MIT 18.655 Mathematical Statistics — lecture notes
sources.version: Spring 2016; official MIT OpenCourseWare graduate course
sources.sections: Lectures 2, 6–18 statistical models, sufficiency, estimation, minimax, limit laws, consistency, delta method, asymptotics and tests; 19–26 Gaussian/GLM examples.

sources.title: CMU 36-705 Intermediate Statistics — lecture notes
sources.sections: Lectures 5–7 convergence/CLT; 11–19 sufficiency/estimation/MLE; 20–27 tests/bootstrap; 29–36 nonparametric, high-dimensional, Bayesian and Fano topics.

sources.title: Convex Optimization / Convex Optimization
sources.version: Boyd & Vandenberghe, 2004; author-hosted free full text and slides updated 2023
sources.sections: Ch. 2.1–2.3 (convex sets/functions and first-order conditions); Ch. 3.1–3.4 (convex functions); Ch. 4.1–4.2 (problem form); Ch. 5.1–5.6 (duality, optimality, sensitivity); Ch. 9.1–9.5, 9.7 (unconstrained descent, gradient, steepest descent, Newton, implementation); Ch. 10.1–10.4 (equality-constrained minimization, constrained Newton, infeasible-start Newton, implementation); Appendix A.5 (linear algebra); Appendix C.2 (solving factored matrices), C.3 (LU/Cholesky/LDLT), C.5 (underdetermined systems).

sources.title: Proximal Algorithms / Proximal Algorithms
sources.version: Parikh & Boyd, Foundations and Trends in Optimization 1(3), 2014; author-hosted final article
sources.sections: §2 proximal-operator properties; §3 proximal interpretations; §4.1 proximal minimization; §4.2 proximal-gradient methods; §6 evaluating proximal operators (not convergence); examples for ℓ1 regularization and projection.

sources.title: 14.384 Time Series Analysis lecture notes / Ghi chú bài giảng 14.384 Time Series Analysis
sources.sections: Lecture Notes 1 (stationarity, lag operator, ARMA, covariance); 2–3 (limit theorems, OLS, HAC); 4–5 (spectrum); 9 (bootstrap); 16 (empirical processes); 17–19 (unit roots, nonstationarity, breaks/cointegration); 21–22 (filtering, state space, Kalman).

sources.title: Time Series and Stochastic Processes lecture notes / Ghi chú bài giảng Time Series and Stochastic Processes
sources.sections: Ch. 27, Theorem 396: α-mixing CLT; theorem proof is cited as technical and is intentionally assumed in this curriculum.

sources.title: A Simple, Positive Semi-Definite, Heteroskedasticity and Autocorrelation Consistent Covariance Matrix / A Simple, Positive Semi-Definite, Heteroskedasticity and Autocorrelation Consistent Covariance Matrix
sources.version: Newey & West, NBER Technical Working Paper 0055 (1986); published Econometrica 55(3), 1987
sources.sections: Theorem 1 (finite-sample positive semidefiniteness). The general consistency result is not claimed as the lesson theorem; bounded m-dependent consistency is proved under explicit hypotheses in this lesson. NBER author working-paper copy is open access.

sources.title: Simulation for Inference I — The Bootstrap / Mô phỏng cho suy luận I — Bootstrap
sources.version: Cosma Shalizi, CMU 36-467/667, 6 November 2018; free companion lecture citing Künsch (1989)
sources.sections: The Resampling Bootstrap; Block bootstrap for time series. The original Künsch theorem remains cited as assumed; this lecture is not the original paper.

sources.title: Strictly Proper Scoring Rules, Prediction, and Estimation / Strictly Proper Scoring Rules, Prediction, and Estimation
sources.version: Gneiting & Raftery, JASA 102(477), 2007, pp. 359–378; author-hosted PDF
sources.sections: §2 propriety and logarithmic score; §3 continuous ranked probability score; exact log-score identity derived in this lesson.

sources.title: Bayesian Filtering and Smoothing / Bayesian Filtering and Smoothing
sources.sections: Second edition, Ch. 5 (state-space models); §6.3 (Kalman filter); §§12.1–12.3 (smoothing equations and RTS); §16.3 (practical parameter estimation). Chapter/section numbers follow the 2023 second-edition contents, not the 2013 first edition. Author-hosted personal-use PDF; lesson text and exercises here are original.

sources.title: 36-705 Intermediate Statistics lecture notes / Ghi chú 36-705 Intermediate Statistics
sources.version: CMU, S. Balakrishnan course notes; accessed 2026-10-09
sources.sections: Lectures 2–10: concentration, convergence, uniform laws, applications, Rademacher complexity; Lectures 26–27: bootstrap; Lectures 30–32: high-dimensional and nonparametric regression.

sources.title: Introduction to Online Convex Optimization / Introduction to Online Convex Optimization
sources.sections: Ch. 2.3 (constrained gradient descent); §3.1 (online gradient descent); §3.3.1 (strongly convex losses); §10.1 (dynamic regret). The path-length OGD bound used here is derived in this lesson.

sources.title: Consistent Covariance Matrix Estimation for Dependent Heterogeneous Processes / Consistent Covariance Matrix Estimation for Dependent Heterogeneous Processes
sources.version: Bruce E. Hansen, Econometrica 60(4), 1992, pp. 967–972; author-hosted PDF
sources.sections: Entire six-page article (pp. 967–972); primary reference for general kernel covariance consistency. This lesson proves only its explicitly stated bounded m-dependent special case and does not claim Hansen’s general theorem.

sources.title: Bandit Algorithms / Bandit Algorithms
sources.version: Lattimore & Szepesvári, 2020 free online edition, author-hosted
sources.sections: Free online edition (same content as print, corrected minor typos): Ch. 1.1 (protocol); §§2.3–2.6 and §5.3 (conditional probability/expectation and concentration); §§4.1–4.5 (stochastic model and pseudo-regret); §7.1 (UCB optimism); §31.2 (stochastic non-stationary bandits); §§34.3–34.6 (conjugate priors, Bayesian bandits/regret); §36.1 (finite-armed Thompson sampling).

sources.title: Särkkä — Bayesian Filtering and Smoothing
sources.sections: §4.3 Kalman filter; §8.2 Rauch–Tung–Striebel smoother; Appendix A.1

sources.title: MIT 6.436J — Fundamentals of Probability
sources.sections: Lectures 7–9 integration, 16–19 convergence/UI, 25–26 martingales; public exams as scope benchmark

sources.title: CMU 36-705 — Lecture 19
sources.sections: §19.2 support failure; §19.3 asymptotic normality; §19.4 influence functions

sources.title: Boyd & Vandenberghe — Convex Optimization
sources.sections: §5.1–5.5 duality/KKT; §9.3 gradient descent; §10.1 equality constraints

sources.title: The Matrix Cookbook
sources.sections: Gaussian distributions, block matrices, matrix identities and determinants; background for the independently derived daily examples.

sources.title: The James-Stein Estimator / Ước lượng James–Stein
sources.sections: Stein’s unbiased risk estimate (SURE).

sources.title: Conformal Prediction / Dự đoán conformal
sources.version: Ryan Tibshirani, Berkeley statistical learning, Spring 2023
sources.sections: Split conformal prediction and calibration rank.

sources.title: Tweedie’s Formula — Stanford EE367 / Công thức Tweedie — Stanford EE367
sources.sections: Tweedie’s formula for additive Gaussian corruption; companion derivation, not the original Efron paper.

sources.title: E-values: Calibration, combination, and applications
sources.sections: E-value definition and arithmetic averaging under arbitrary dependence.

coverage.topic: Diagnostic prerequisites: algebra, derivative, rank, conditional probability, quantified proof
coverage.evidence: Self-contained diagnostic definitions and five solved/rubric-scored tasks; Week 1 A/B forms replace one another.

coverage.topic: Proof language, functions, induction
coverage.evidence: Five proof-focused exercises with full witness/counterexample and pointwise rubric.

coverage.topic: Euclidean geometry, inequalities, identifiability
coverage.evidence: Cauchy–Schwarz proof and five transfer/proof tasks; finite-dimensional setup is explicit.

coverage.topic: Single-variable calculus, finite differences, Taylor remainder
coverage.evidence: Product rule proved from difference quotients; failure of differentiability and bounded Taylor remainder are solved.

coverage.topic: Vector spaces, maps, rank–nullity
coverage.evidence: General rank–nullity proof, constructed maps, and an identifiability theorem task.

coverage.topic: Orthogonal projection and least squares
coverage.evidence: Projection theorem with existence/uniqueness proof; normal equations and non-unique coefficients treated explicitly.

coverage.topic: Spectral theorem, PSD, covariance geometry
coverage.evidence: Inductive spectral proof and covariance nullspace characterization with a nonsymmetric counterexample.

coverage.topic: SVD, pseudoinverse, conditioning, stable least squares
coverage.evidence: SVD proof from AᵀA; numerical stability and rank-deficient solution ambiguity are treated explicitly.

coverage.topic: Multivariable derivative and chain rule
coverage.evidence: Fréchet chain-rule proof, matrix shape exercise and partials-without-differentiability counterexample.

coverage.topic: Hessian, Taylor bounds, constrained extrema
coverage.evidence: Taylor remainder proved via one-dimensional integral remainder; multiplier failure is constructed.

coverage.topic: Double integrals and change of variables
coverage.evidence: Local area interpretation, theorem with conditions and proof sketch, and explicit many-to-one failure case.

coverage.topic: Completeness and convergence of real sequences
coverage.evidence: Supremum proof plus Cauchy, subsequence and recurrence exercises with explicit quantifiers.

coverage.topic: Continuity, compactness, uniform continuity
coverage.evidence: Compact sequential proof and explicit noncompact-domain counterexample.

coverage.topic: Pointwise/uniform convergence and continuity
coverage.evidence: Uniform-limit continuity proof, sup-norm exercises, and derivative interchange failure boundary.

coverage.topic: Riemann integration and interchange
coverage.evidence: Uniform integral bound proved; counterexample distinguishes pointwise convergence and integral convergence.

coverage.topic: Cumulative linear algebra/calculus/analysis readiness
coverage.evidence: Theorem and 10 original A/B gate exercises; sessions schedule five A tasks with B substitutions.

coverage.topic: Probability models, event algebra and counting
coverage.evidence: Axioms/addition rule and five tasks spanning proof, counting, and nonuniform models.

coverage.topic: Conditional probability, Bayes and independence
coverage.evidence: Partition proof, base-rate example, and explicit distinction between independence and mutual exclusivity.

coverage.topic: Discrete random variables and moments
coverage.evidence: Expectation/variance identities proved; zero-covariance dependence counterexample and indicator transfer included.

coverage.topic: Continuous/joint variables and density transforms
coverage.evidence: Transformation derivation, triangular support, conditional density, and dependence counterexample.

coverage.topic: Markov/Chebyshev concentration
coverage.evidence: Both inequalities proved from nonnegative variables; loose-bound and sample-size examples included.

coverage.topic: WLLN and CLT bridge
coverage.evidence: WLLN proved via Chebyshev; CLT normalization, finite-sample approximation and dependence failure separated.

coverage.topic: Finite Markov chains and invariant measures
coverage.evidence: Invariant-distribution proof, detailed-balance criterion and periodic nonconvergence counterexample.

coverage.topic: Sampling distributions, estimation, confidence intervals
coverage.evidence: Sample-mean moments proved; MSE, prediction target and coverage interpretation exercised.

coverage.topic: Likelihood, MLE, identifiability
coverage.evidence: Gaussian mean MLE proof, boundary MLE, posterior distinction and nonidentifiable parameterization.

coverage.topic: Sufficiency and Rao–Blackwell
coverage.evidence: Factorization and variance decomposition proofs; completeness boundary is treated honestly.

coverage.topic: Testing, likelihood ratios and error control
coverage.evidence: Neyman–Pearson proof, p-value distinction, family-wise error and predeclared-tail transfer.

coverage.topic: Bootstrap/permutation and undergraduate-to-graduate bridge
coverage.evidence: Finite-group validity proof sketch, exact small permutation orbit and serial-dependence failure derivation.

coverage.topic: Probability spaces, events, measurable maps, pushforward laws
coverage.evidence: Definition and fully proved integration identity; five exercises include transformed and joint laws.

coverage.topic: Carathéodory extension theorem proof
coverage.evidence: Probability measures are the starting structure; extension proof is named as beyond this sequence.

coverage.topic: Simple integral, nonnegative and signed expectation
coverage.evidence: Definition, monotonicity proof, dyadic approximation, and signed divergence exercise.

coverage.topic: Outer-measure construction of Lebesgue measure
coverage.evidence: Probability measures are starting objects; Carathéodory construction proof is beyond this selected core.

coverage.topic: MCT and Fatou for nonnegative functions
coverage.evidence: Fatou fully derived from MCT; exercises prove it and test strictness.

coverage.topic: Reverse Fatou with integrable domination
coverage.evidence: Derived by applying Fatou to Y−X_n with finite subtraction checked.

coverage.topic: DCT and expectation-limit interchange
coverage.evidence: DCT hypotheses, Fatou proof sketch, strict failure and parameterized transfer.

coverage.topic: Tonelli/Fubini and infinite-sum interchange
coverage.evidence: Rectangle section calculation, absolute-integrability boundary, and nonnegative-series proof.

coverage.topic: Lp, Hölder, Jensen, Cauchy–Schwarz and moment interpolation
coverage.evidence: Hölder proved from Young; five exercises include strict Jensen and an L¹∖L² counterexample.

coverage.topic: Completeness and general duality of Lp
coverage.evidence: Norms are defined; Banach-space completeness and general dual-space theorem are not claimed.

coverage.topic: Independence, product factorization, and both Borel–Cantelli lemmas
coverage.evidence: Both lemmas fully proved; exercise transfers summable errors to a.s. convergence and includes a dependence counterexample.

coverage.topic: Zero-one laws and large deviations
coverage.evidence: These are outside the selected 16-week graduate-probability core.

coverage.topic: Conditional expectation via RN and a.s. uniqueness
coverage.evidence: Existence is explicitly assumed and sourced; uniqueness is fully proved; finite-partition and null-version tasks are scheduled.

coverage.topic: Proof of the RN theorem
coverage.evidence: RN is an advanced named black box; no proof claim.

coverage.topic: Tower, bounded pull-out, conditional identities and L² projection
coverage.evidence: Tower and L² orthogonality fully proved; finite partition risk is derived; bounded pull-out is proved by simple approximation.

coverage.topic: General Banach-space conditional expectation
coverage.evidence: Only the standard L¹ definition and L² projection are covered.

coverage.topic: a.s., probability, Lp and distributional convergence
coverage.evidence: Definitions, proved a.s.⇒probability and Lp⇒probability, plus rare-event converse failure.

coverage.topic: Portmanteau theorem and weak topology
coverage.evidence: Distributional convergence is defined; general Portmanteau proof is reserved for an advanced probability sequence.

coverage.topic: Uniform integrability, expectation tails and Vitali L¹ convergence
coverage.evidence: UI definition, spike counterexample, bounded-core lemma and truncation proof sketch with exact source.

coverage.topic: Dunford–Pettis theorem and weak compactness
coverage.evidence: Beyond this probability/statistics sequence; UI is used only in the scalar Vitali theorem.

coverage.topic: Weak LLN under finite variance
coverage.evidence: Chebyshev proof required as a scheduled derivation and applied to Bernoulli samples.

coverage.topic: Strong LLN iid finite first moment
coverage.evidence: Exact theorem and moment condition stated, sourced as assumed; full truncation proof is beyond this sequence.

coverage.topic: Weak convergence, characteristic functions, CMT and Slutsky
coverage.evidence: Definitions, Slutsky proof sketch with exact black-box boundary, five application/proof/counterexample tasks.

coverage.topic: Portmanteau theorem proof and tightness theory
coverage.evidence: Used only as a named characterization in the sourced Slutsky argument.

coverage.topic: iid finite-variance CLT and characteristic-function derivation
coverage.evidence: Second-order expansion and nth-power limit are derived; Lévy continuity is explicitly assumed.

coverage.topic: Berry–Esseen rates, Lindeberg triangular-array CLT, stable-law limits
coverage.evidence: Finite-variance iid CLT is the selected core; rates, arrays and heavy-tail limit laws are extensions.

coverage.topic: Finite Markov chains, invariant laws and mixing
coverage.evidence: Stationarity calculation, fully proved minorization contraction/uniqueness, geometric bound, periodic counterexample.

coverage.topic: General-state recurrence, continuous-time chains and ergodic theory
coverage.evidence: Beyond the finite-state selected process core.

coverage.topic: Filtrations, adapted martingales, increment orthogonality, bounded optional stopping
coverage.evidence: Bounded stopping fully proved via stopped increments; conditional orthogonality proved; unbounded first-hit failure is explicit.

coverage.topic: Doob convergence/maximal inequalities and general optional-stopping criteria
coverage.evidence: Only finite-horizon optional stopping is proved; broader convergence and UI stopping criteria require an extension sequence.

coverage.topic: Probability-space, integration, convergence, LLN/CLT and conditional-expectation synthesis
coverage.evidence: Five scheduled form-A tasks and five distinct form-B replacements span measure, CE/L², limit laws, Markov chains, and martingale stopping.

coverage.topic: Full graduate probability prelim syllabus
coverage.evidence: Gate tests selected first-course graduate core only; Levy processes, Brownian stochastic calculus and general martingale convergence remain extensions.

coverage.topic: Likelihood, identifiability, finite factorization criterion and exponential-family statistics
coverage.evidence: Factorization criterion proved both ways; Bernoulli/Poisson examples and an insufficient-statistic counterexample.

coverage.topic: Minimal sufficiency in general dominated models
coverage.evidence: Sufficiency is taught; minimal-sufficiency likelihood-ratio criterion is reference material, not claimed as proved.

coverage.topic: Rao–Blackwell variance improvement and completeness uniqueness
coverage.evidence: Variance decomposition proved; completeness uniqueness proved; UMVU theorem derived conditional on a named completeness result.

coverage.topic: General characterization of complete sufficient statistics
coverage.evidence: Selected binomial family used; broad exponential-family completeness classification is not claimed.

coverage.topic: Neyman–Pearson simple hypotheses and likelihood-ratio ordering
coverage.evidence: Optimality inequality proved; randomization and composite-alternative failure addressed in five scheduled tasks.

coverage.topic: Uniformly most powerful tests for broad composite families
coverage.evidence: Scope and additional monotone-likelihood-ratio condition named; general theory deferred.

coverage.topic: Score, Fisher information, score identity and scalar Cramér–Rao
coverage.evidence: Score identities and Cauchy–Schwarz proof; Bernoulli equality and Uniform support failure.

coverage.topic: Information inequalities for irregular/nonparametric models
coverage.evidence: Classical regular scalar bound only; irregular and semiparametric bounds are extensions.

coverage.topic: M-estimator consistency and uniform laws
coverage.evidence: Argmax theorem proved; finite-net route and pointwise-only counterexample supplied.

coverage.topic: General noncompact argmax theorem
coverage.evidence: Compactness supplies separation; coercivity alternatives are extensions.

coverage.topic: Smooth M-estimator asymptotic normality and sandwich covariance
coverage.evidence: First-order expansion derived from stated score CLT and uniform derivative LLN; correct and misspecified cases compared.

coverage.topic: Semiparametric efficiency and dependent-score limits
coverage.evidence: Finite-dimensional iid estimating equations only; broader efficiency and dependence theory are extensions.

coverage.topic: First-order scalar delta method and second-order degenerate case
coverage.evidence: Taylor remainder proof, log/proportion transfers, and zero-derivative chi-square scaling.

coverage.topic: Nondifferentiable directional delta method in general
coverage.evidence: Absolute-value limit follows directly by continuous mapping; general directional theory is not claimed.

coverage.topic: Nonparametric bootstrap for the iid mean
coverage.evidence: Conditional variance and CLT target derived; conditional triangular-array CLT explicitly cited as theorem.

coverage.topic: Exact permutation tests and randomization inference
coverage.evidence: Finite-orbit rank proof, worked assignment enumeration, sharp-null requirement and unequal-variance caveat.

coverage.topic: Dependent bootstrap methods
coverage.evidence: An exact perfect-dependence counterexample is shown; block-bootstrap theory is deferred.

coverage.topic: Kernel density estimation bias, variance and bandwidth rate
coverage.evidence: Convolution/Taylor bias and variance derivation, MSE optimization, boundary and dimension examples.

coverage.topic: Uniform density confidence bands and adaptive bandwidth selection
coverage.evidence: Pointwise leading-order behavior only; empirical-process bands and adaptation require broader theory.

coverage.topic: Two-point minimax lower bound under squared error
coverage.evidence: Testing reduction proved; Bernoulli KL/Pinsker example provides an explicit 1/n lower bound.

coverage.topic: Fano packing bounds and broad nonparametric minimax rates
